objective: Build Silent Voice Reader — voice-controlled silent reading experience with privacy-first design, audio processing, and distraction-free reading interface

steps.task: Define requirements: voice-controlled reading, privacy-first audio processing, distraction-free UI, offline-first PWA. Map to SHHH widget patterns.

Create wireframes: (1) cover page with voice activation, (2) reading view with scrollable text, (3) voice control panel (play/pause/seek), (4) settings (voice quality, volume, language). Validate against mindfulness-focused PWA patterns.

Implement core modules: (1) Web Speech API for speech recognition, (2) Text rendering with smooth scrolling, (3) Voice control buttons (Play/Pause/Seek), (4) Settings panel, (5) Offline-first storage for book cache.
Test voice accuracy, performance on low-end devices, accessibility (screen reader support), and privacy compliance (no cloud recording). Run cross-browser checks.
Prepare production build, generate manifest, verify PWA capabilities, and document usage.
